label: World generation or destruction…: In CosmicGenerationDestructionRequiresMotionReading, Event…
term: world generation or destruction occurrence and accompanying motion
definition: In CosmicGenerationDestructionRequiresMotionReading, Event ranges over occurrences, CosmicGenerationOrDestruction e means that e is a world coming to be or perishing, and Accompanies e x r means that physical motion of subject x in respect r occurs with e. Coming to be and perishing concern the world, not merely a change of its place, quality or quantity; the motion accompanies that event without being identified with it. No date, duration, causal direction or temporal precedence is encoded.
note: Event-indexed bookkeeping for the parenthetical world-generation/destruction requirement at Physics VIII.1, 250b18-23. It separates substantial coming-to-be/perishing from accompanying physical motion; it supplies no independent account of what constitutes a world.
